summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository root, plan directory, canonical output path, maintainer refresh flag, and in-plan skill-input receipt; contract and output path must match canonical plan locations; initial state must be plan-ready with authorizes=[plan-ready]; refresh requires implementation-authorized state, explicit flag, expected predecessor receipt, and preserves prior output under hash-derived repair path; state/resume advance to implementation-authorized/run-slice; skill input must validate as ready against repository skill-input contract; generation binds receipt, source-selection, selected-content-root, context, semantic-decision, and child-request hashes, then derives generation root; receipt binds contract, registries, manifests, frozen knowledge, validation/closure/delta/candidate artifacts, validators, and immutable predecessor; candidate binding hash covers bindings plus generation; writes successor authorization receipt and appends implementation report; authorizes implementation-authorized only; explicitly excludes completion, acceptance, knowledge publication, bootstrap review, and release; receipt includes a malformed-looking predecessor_authorization=<redacted>; output reports pass, receipt path, and authorization
